title: Uncovering Grounding IDs: How External Cues Shape Multi-Modal Binding
abstract: arXiv:2509.24072v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) perform well on multimodal tasks, but their ability to reason and precisely align visual and textual information still has room for improvement. In this study, we show that external visual cues, such as symbols or grid lines, help LVLMs form more accurate connections between visual components, such as objects, and their corresponding textual descriptions, improving their grounding and reasoning abilities. We introduce the concept of Grounding IDs, which are latent identifiers that arise within the model as a result of external cues structuring both visual and textual modalities. Our analysis reveals that partition-inducing external cues lead to Grounding IDs that make better alignment between corresponding visual and text representations, helping the model focus on relevant information. translated_title: 揭示接地标识：外部线索如何塑造多模态绑定
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型在多模态任务上表现良好，但其推理能力以及精确对齐视觉与文本信息的能力仍有提升空间。在本研究中，我们证明了外部视觉线索（如符号或网格线）能够帮助大型视觉语言模型在视觉组件（如物体）与其对应的文本描述之间建立更准确的连接，从而提升其接地和推理能力。我们提出了“接地标识”的概念，这是一种由外部线索对视觉和文本模态进行结构化后在模型内部产生的潜在标识符。我们的分析揭示，诱导分区的外部线索所产生的接地标识能够使对应的视觉表征和文本表征之间实现更好的对齐，帮助模型聚焦于相关信息。我们发现接地标识增强了相关组件之间的注意力，从而改善了跨模态接地能力。
tldr: 外部视觉线索（如符号和网格线）能促使大型视觉语言模型内部产生“接地标识”这一潜在标识符，从而增强视觉与文本表征的对齐并改善跨模态接地能力。
en_tdlr: External visual cues (such as symbols and grid lines) induce latent "Grounding IDs" within large vision-language models, enhancing the alignment between visual and text representations and improving cross-modal grounding.
